A '''spiritualist''' was an individual who attempted to contact the [[Bedlam Spirits|spirits]] of the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] for a fee. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], members of the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[Species/Legends|species]] consulted spiritualists and [[Seer (profession)|seers]] to contact their dead and ensure that [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] rites had been adequately performed for them.<ref name="S">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>
